biggest_catch: Paid as a $50 Visa Reward Card (not cash) that expires 3 months after issuance — and only after your friend keeps the new checking account open in good standing for 60 days plus completes a debit purchase and $100+ direct deposit.
catches: Reward is a $50 Visa Reward Card per qualifying referral, not a cash deposit — cards expire 3 months after issuance
Referrer must register for the program and submit valid email addresses for both parties; only the FIRST referrer to submit a friend's email is eligible for that friend
Friend must be new to BankPlus personal checking, register via the referral link, and open the account within 90 days of receiving the offer
Friend must complete within 60 days of opening: 1 debit-card purchase (posted and cleared) AND 1 direct deposit of $100+ (payroll or government only) AND enroll in online banking
Friend's account must stay open and in good standing for at least 60 days (no continuous overdrafts or fraud)
No annual referral cap is stated in the official terms
Reward Card mailed to the address in the ReferLive registration system; allow 4-6 weeks after all requirements are completed
18+ only; BankPlus/affiliate employees ineligible; cannot combine with other offers; program can be discontinued at any time
Reward card amounts may be reported to the IRS; recipient responsible for taxes
BankPlus is a Mississippi-based regional bank (also AL, LA, TX) — membership/branch footprint applies

steps: Be a BankPlus customer 18+ and register for the Refer-A-Friend program
Submit valid email addresses for yourself and each friend you refer (first submitter wins for each friend)
Friend registers via your referral link and opens a new BankPlus personal checking account within 90 days

Friend completes within 60 days: 1 debit-card purchase (posted/cleared) + 1 payroll/government direct deposit of $100+ (posted/cleared) + online banking enrollment, and keeps the account open in good standing 60 days
You receive a $50 Visa Reward Card by mail 4-6 weeks after all requirements are completed
timing: Registering + submitting a referral takes ~5-10 minutes active; the $50 Visa Reward Card is mailed 4-6 weeks after the friend completes the 60-day qualification window.
